players.bio: Alan Isaac Mwamba is an English professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for EFL Championship club Charlton Athletic.

Amari'i Kyren Bell (born 5 May 1994) is a professional footballer is a left back who plays for EFL Championship club Charlton Athletic and the Jamaica national team. He spent time on loan at Conference Premier club Nuneaton Town in the first half of the 2013–14 season before making his Football League debut for Birmingham in January 2014.

Arthur Chukwuezugo Okonkwo Listen is a professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for EFL Championship club Charlton Athletic on loan from EFL Championship club Wrexham. Early life Born in London, Okonkwo began his career at Hampstead Academy before moving on to Lindus Park, where he joined the Arsenal academy as an eight-year-old in 2009.
Billy Dawson Koumetio (born 14 November 2002) is a French professional footballer who plays as a centre-back or left-back for EFL Championship club Charlton Athletic.

Charlie Robert Martin Lee-Kelman (born November 2, 2001) is a professional soccer player who plays as a forward for EFL Championship club Charlton Athletic. Born in England, he represents the United States internationally.

Collins Lusaka Sichenje (born 19 September 2003) is a Kenyan professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for EFL Championship club Charlton Athletic. Club career Early career Sichenje started his career with Green Commandos. After that, he signed for Kenyan Premier League side AFC Leopards in September 2019.

Conor James Coventry is a professional footballer who plays as a defensive midfielder for EFL Championship club Charlton Athletic and the Republic of Ireland national team. He has also played on loan for Lincoln City, Peterborough United and Milton Keynes Dons. Born in England, he represents the Republic of Ireland at youth international level.
Danny John McNamara is a professional footballer who plays as a full back for EFL Championship club Charlton Athletic.

Harvey Andrew Knibbs (born 26 April 1999) is an English professional footballer who plays as an Attacking midfielder and forward for EFL Championship club Charlton Athletic. Club career Early career Knibbs was raised in Derbyshire and joined the Nottingham Forest academy as a child before moving to the Aston Villa Academy.
Ivan Mesík is a Slovak professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for EFL Championship club Charlton Athletic and the Slovakia national team.

Joseph Scott Rankin-Costello (born 26 July 1999) is an English professional footballer who plays for EFL Championship club Charlton Athletic as a defender or midfielder. Career Rankin-Costello kicked off his career with Manchester United academy before moving to the Blackburn Rovers academy in 2014.

Joshua Edwards (born 27 May 2000) is a Scottish footballer who plays as a defender for EFL Championship club Charlton Athletic. Edwards began his career with Airdrieonians and has also played for Dunfermline Athletic.

Karlan Laughton Ahearne-Grant is an English professional footballer who plays as a forward for EFL Championship club Charlton Athletic. He has represented England at youth level and is also eligible to represent Scotland.
Kayne Richard Junior Ramsay (born 10 October 2000) is an English professional footballer who plays as a defender for EFL Championship club Charlton Athletic
Lloyd Richard Jones (born 7 October 1995) is an English professional footballer who plays as a defender for Charlton Athletic.

Matthew James Godden (born 29 July 1991) is an English professional footballer who plays as a striker for EFL Championship club Charlton Athletic. Godden began his career with Scunthorpe United, signing professional terms in 2009.
Micah Lionel Mbick (born 8 November 2006) is an English professional footballer who plays as a forward for EFL Championship club Charlton Athletic.
Miles Lester Leaburn (born 28 November 2003) is an English professional footballer who plays as a forward for EFL Championship club Charlton Athletic
Millenic Oluwole Sulaiman Alli is an Irish professional footballer who plays as a winger for EFL Championship club Charlton Athletic and the Republic of Ireland national team.

Nathan Jason Jones (born 28 May 1973) is a Welsh professional football manager who is the manager of League One club Charlton Athletic. He is also a former player who played as a left-back and a midfielder. Jones began his career with Football Conference club Merthyr Tydfil before joining Luton Town in the summer of 1995.

Nathaniel Nyakie Chalobah is a professional footballer who plays as a defensive midfielder for EFL Championship club Charlton Athletic. Born in Sierra Leone, he has represented the England national team.
Oliver William Skipp is an English professional footballer who plays as a defensive midfielder for EFL Championship club Charlton Athletic on loan from EFL League One club Leicester City.

Reece Frederick James Burke (born 2 September 1996) is an English professional footballer who plays as a defender for EFL Championship club Charlton Athletic. Mainly a centre-back, he can also play as a left-back. A product of the West Ham United youth system, Burke has also played for Bradford City, where he was the player of the season for the 2015–16 season, and Bolton Wanderers.

Robert Julian Apter (born 23 April 2003) is a professional footballer who plays as a right midfielder for EFL Championship club Charlton Athletic. Born in England, he has represented Scotland at under-19 level.

Sonny Jack Carey (born 20 January 2001) is an English professional footballer who plays for Charlton Athletic, as a midfielder. Career Born in Norwich, Carey spent his early career with Norwich City and King's Lynn Town. He signed for Blackpool in June 2021.
Tiernan Jon Brooks (born 17 June 2002) is a professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for EFL Championship club Charlton Athletic.

Timothy Noor Babu Ouma (born 10 June 2004) is a Kenyan professional footballer who plays as a defensive midfielder for EFL Championship club Charlton Athletic on loan from Czech First League club Slavia Prague and the Kenya national team.

Tyler Grant Bindon is a New Zealand professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for EFL Championship club Charlton Athletic on loan from Premier League side Nottingham Forest, and the New Zealand national team.
Tyreece Anthony Tupac Shakur Campbell is a professional footballer who plays as a forward or winger for EFL Championship club Charlton Athletic.
William John Mannion (born 5 May 1998) is an English professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for EFL Championship club Charlton Athletic
